So a census count is NEITHER an upper nor a lower bound, and a census NEGATIVE - 'no censused access' - ESTABLISHES NOTHING. That is not hypothetical: a padding row published on a linear table at ImageAddressArenaRecord +0x8C was withdrawn the same day when a reader and a writer turned up in a body the walk had lost. NOTHING IS RETRACTED HERE and no readiness, confidence or name is changed - the store-wide re-run and the disposition ruling are routed as OPUS-REQ-FRONTIER-SHARED-CENSUS-WALKS-LINEARLY-NO-CFG.
